name: IOI Corporation Berhad
overview: 2026财年，IOI Corporation Berhad 的种植板块鲜果串、棕榈油和棕榈仁产量同比均有所增加，椰子产量亦录得增长；橡胶产量则大幅下降，并在部分季度降至零。公司未公告新的业务扩张、出售或合约事项，业务动态主要体现在月度及季度产量披露中。
overview_en: In FY2026, IOI Corporation Berhad's plantation segment recorded higher fresh fruit bunch, crude palm oil and palm kernel production year-on-year, with coconut output also increasing; rubber production declined substantially and fell to zero in some quarters. The company did not announce any new business expansion, divestment or contract, with business developments mainly reflected in monthly and quarterly production disclosures.

segments.name: 种植
segments.note: 2026财年棕榈油、鲜果串及棕榈仁产量同比增加，椰子产量增长，橡胶产量大幅减少并在部分季度为零。
segments.note_en: In FY2026, crude palm oil, fresh fruit bunch and palm kernel production increased year-on-year, coconut output grew, while rubber production fell sharply and was zero in some quarters.
